thread:
acme-cust-ops: hey folks — noticed ~1.2k objects that hit TTL 30d last week are still searchable and customer get 500s calling DELETE /v1/objects/<id>. Account acme-prod-42. need ETA on purges and if this is a compliance risk :grimacing:
emma-support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact curl you used and one full 500 response body? also are these objects under any custom retention or legal hold?
acme-cust-ops: curl --location --request DELETE 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/objects/obj-8a7b' \n  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx'
response: {"error":"internal_server_error","message":"decryption failure: hsm timeout"}
not on hold, default 30d TTL across bucket 'acme-prod-logs'
emma-support: thanks. can you confirm the earliest TTL expiry in that set? any chance these span a wide range?
acme-cust-ops: earliest expiry 2026-02-26, latest 2026-03-02. all should have been tombstoned automatically. we first noticed on 2026-03-03
raj-oncall: looping in SRE — tagging @maria-sre. also creating internal ticket SUP-2026-9882
maria-sre: initial read: DELETE hitting internal tombstone worker which tries to decrypt metadata via KMS before removing index entries. KMS returned transient HSM timeouts around 2026-03-02 03:00-03:40 UTC causing a processing backlog. That can leave objects in an inconsistent state: tombstone not applied but index still shows object.
acme-cust-ops: ok... is this something you can clear remotely or do we need to do anything on our end? legal is breathing down my neck.
olivia-legal: we need confirmation whether any preservation holds should be set before any bulk purge. if there is litigation hold we must not delete. do we have an audit log of attempted deletions during the outage?
emma-support: we have logs. can you confirm if Acme has any active legal hold flags in their account? I don't see one in console but will double-check with account team.
acme-cust-ops: no holds configured from our side. we do have a downstream backup but it's not canonical for retention requests.
maria-sre: next steps: 1) we will re-run tombstone reconciliation job against acme-prod-42 objects after KMS backlog clears. 2) if reconciliation fails due to decryption, we'll fallback to index-only tombstoning (non-destructive) and mark objects for manual review. 3) we'll provide audit entries for each attempted delete. estimated time to start reconciliation: ~25 minutes, ETA completion ~90 minutes depending on backlog depth.
kms-bot: [KMS ALERT] Key rotation window 2026-03-02T03:00:00Z - 2026-03-02T03:45:00Z: observed peak HSM queueing, transient session timeouts ~0.6% of ops.
emma-support: tagging account team to confirm no holds and authorizing remediation: @acme-cust-ops can we proceed with reconciliation and index-only tombstone fallback if needed?
acme-cust-ops: please proceed. we authorize remediation and want audit logs + list of IDs affected.
maria-sre: acknowledged. I'm kicking off a scoped reconciliation job for account acme-prod-42 now. I'll paste progress and a link to the job run when available.
emma-support: created external case: 2026-SUP-ACME-9882. linking to internal SUP-2026-9882. will update customer-facing timeline after SRE posts job link. :thumbsup:
maria-sre: job started. current progress: scanning 1.2k objects, 0/1200 reconciled yet. if we hit decryption failures we'll capture stack and escalate to KMS team for HSM retry window.
acme-cust-ops: appreciated. can you also include whether this could have impacted billing (we saw unexpected storage charges last month)?
emma-support: will check billing lineage and flag potential double-counting while objects were 'visible' post TTL. I'll include billing ops in the case.
olivia-legal: please preserve export of these objects and the audit trail until we confirm final disposition. do not purge until I sign off once recon completes.
maria-sre: noted. we'll produce export and audit. for safety, we'll mark objects as 'pending-deletion:legal-pending' in internal metadata until legal clears. that prevents automated purge.
akms-bot: manual note: if reconciliation needs to bypass full KMS decrypt (index-only tombstone), keys are not accessed and HSM is not involved — data remains encrypted at rest; we only update index state.
emma-support: next update in ~30m or sooner if job finishes. thanks for quick responses everyone.
acme-cust-ops: thanks all. please cc compliance when you have audit dump.
(attachments: request_id=2026-SUP-ACME-9882, logs.zip, job_run_link=https://internal.redwood/jobs/2026-7764)
